- Ask your dentist for referrals
- Check if they're board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics

**What to look for:**
- Experience with both traditional braces and Invisalign
- Clear communication about treatment plans and costs
- Good patient reviews mentioning comfort and results
- Flexible payment options
- Convenient location/hours

- Midtown/Plaza area
- Westport
